s0101.literal: On dingmao day an edict was issued to the provinces regarding relay seal documents.
s0101.idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict was issued to the provinces regarding relay seal documents.

s0102.literal: On wuchen day the Jiangxi and Fujian branch secretariats were merged, redundant Jiangnan officials were cut, commercial levies on Fujian mountain counties and market towns were remitted, and private persons on the routes usurping control of prefecture, zhou, bureau, and county offices were forbidden.
s0102.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Jiangxi and Fujian branch secretariats were merged, redundant Jiangnan officials were cut, commercial levies on Fujian mountain counties and market towns were remitted, and private persons on the routes usurping control of prefecture, zhou, bureau, and county offices were forbidden.

s0103.literal: The She cave people were summoned to submit and their crimes remitted.
s0103.idiomatic: The She cave people were summoned to submit and their crimes remitted.

s0104.literal: The practice of detailing garrison troops for prisoner escort was forbidden.
s0104.idiomatic: The practice of detailing garrison troops for prisoner escort was forbidden.

s0105.literal: Craft commissioners were forbidden to recruit artisan households on their own authority.
s0105.idiomatic: Craft commissioners were forbidden to recruit artisan households on their own authority.

s0106.literal: On jisi day Liu Xuan, associate commissioner of the Zhexi Route pacification commission, and others were dispatched to audit receipts and disbursements of each salt transport commission and the tea transport bureaus of the revenue offices.
s0106.idiomatic: On jisi day Liu Xuan, associate commissioner of the Zhexi Route pacification commission, and others were sent to audit receipts and disbursements of each salt transport commission and the tea transport bureaus of the revenue offices.

s0107.literal: The assets operated by Ahmad's wife, children, and kin were registered, and their slaves were released as commoners.
s0107.idiomatic: The assets operated by Ahmad's wife, children, and kin were registered, and their slaves were released as commoners.

s0108.literal: The concurrent ranks attached to pacification commissioners were abolished.
s0108.idiomatic: The concurrent ranks attached to pacification commissioners were abolished.

s0109.literal: On renshen day Geng Ren was shackled and brought to Dadu; the Central Secretariat was ordered to try him.
s0109.idiomatic: On renshen day Geng Ren was shackled and brought to Dadu; the Central Secretariat was ordered to try him.

s0110.literal: On gengchen day deliberation was held on building ships at Pingluan Prefecture; nine thousand troops and civilians combined were mobilized, with temechi Bieyadai placed in command to cut timber in the mountains and also take it from temples, monasteries, and graves, the state paying fair value; Sangge was also ordered to send men to supervise.
s0110.idiomatic: On gengchen day deliberation was held on building ships at Pingluan Prefecture; 9,000 troops and civilians combined were mobilized, with temechi Bieyadai placed in command to cut timber in the mountains and also take it from temples, monasteries, and graves, the state paying fair value; Sangge was also ordered to send men to supervise.

s0111.literal: On guiwei day summer clothing was issued to the Dadu Badu'er regular troops.
s0111.idiomatic: On guiwei day summer clothing was issued to the Dadu Badu'er regular troops.

s0112.literal: Huluhuosun said: "Among the seven hundred fourteen superfluous officials in the secretariat and ministries, five hundred eighty-one without fault may temporarily be retained.
s0112.idiomatic: Huluhuosun said, "Among the 714 superfluous officials in the secretariat and ministries, 581 without fault may temporarily be retained.

s0113.literal: " The left associate commander-in-chief of the coastal forces, Shi Guoying, asked that tax households support the army, with those whose soldiers deserted or died required to make up the numbers;
s0113.idiomatic: " Left associate coastal commander-in-chief Shi Guoying asked that tax households support the army, with those whose soldiers deserted or died required to make up the numbers;

s0114.literal: relay household seed tax, where rich and poor were uneven, their corvée should be equalized.
s0114.idiomatic: relay household seed tax, where rich and poor were uneven, should be equalized.

s0115.literal: He also asked to implement the salt law, cut officials, and abolish hunting households.
s0115.idiomatic: He also asked to implement the salt law, cut officials, and abolish hunting households.

s0116.literal: An edict ordered the Central Secretariat to deliberate and implement these measures.
s0116.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Central Secretariat to deliberate and implement these measures.

s0117.literal: Zhang Hui and Ali were dismissed.
s0117.idiomatic: Zhang Hui and Ali were dismissed.

s0118.literal: Gansu branch secretariat left vice minister Maitingding was made right vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat, and Branch Censorate censor-in-chief Zhang Xiongfei was made associate administrator.
s0118.idiomatic: Gansu branch secretariat left vice minister Maitingding was made right vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat, and branch censorate censor-in-chief Zhang Xiongfei was made associate administrator.

s0119.literal: On yiyou day commander-in-chief Qi Gongzhi said: "I ask that deserters be branded and still made to serve in the army, and that smelting works be established at Bie Shibali to cast farm implements.
s0119.idiomatic: On yiyou day commander-in-chief Qi Gongzhi said, "I ask that deserters be branded and still made to serve in the army, and that smelting works be established at Bie Shibali to cast farm implements.

s0121.literal: On bingxu day locusts three hundred li east of Bie Shibali destroyed the wheat crop.
s0121.idiomatic: On bingxu day locusts 300 li east of Bie Shibali destroyed the wheat crop.

s0122.literal: Sixth month, on the jichou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
s0122.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jichou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

s0124.literal: On jiawu day Ahmad had arbitrarily established two hundred four offices; an edict retained thirty-three and abolished the rest.
s0124.idiomatic: On jiawu day Ahmad had arbitrarily established 204 offices; an edict retained 33 and abolished the rest.

s0125.literal: Of the fifteen Jiangnan pacification commissions, four had already had branch secretariats established and were abolished.
s0125.idiomatic: Of the 15 Jiangnan pacification commissions, four that already had branch secretariats were abolished.

s0126.literal: On yiwei day seven hundred seventy garrison-farm troops from Liupan Mountain were dispatched to fill out Liu En's army.
s0126.idiomatic: On yiwei day 770 garrison-farm troops from Liupan Mountain were dispatched to fill out Liu En's army.

s0127.literal: An edict forbade pacification commissioners and other officials to employ regular troops as corvée.
s0127.idiomatic: An edict forbade pacification commissioners and other officials to employ regular troops as corvée.

s0128.literal: On bingshen day one hundred archers were dispatched to guard the chancellor; others were not permitted to cite this as precedent.
s0128.idiomatic: On bingshen day 100 archers were dispatched to guard the chancellor; others were not permitted to cite this as precedent.

s0129.literal: On wuxu day, because Champa had submitted and then rebelled again, five thousand troops from Huai, Zhe, Fujian, and Huguang, one hundred sea ships, and two hundred fifty war vessels were dispatched, with Suodu placed in command to suppress them.
s0129.idiomatic: On wuxu day, because Champa had submitted and then rebelled again, 5,000 troops from Huai, Zhe, Fujian, and Huguang, 100 sea ships, and 250 war vessels were dispatched under Suodu to suppress them.

s0130.literal: Former Song troops, whether with hand marks or without hand marks, were all permitted to become civilians.
s0130.idiomatic: Former Song troops, whether with hand marks or without, were all permitted to become civilians.

s0131.literal: On jihai day He Zizhi was made army-commanding wanhu and sent as envoy to Siam.
s0131.idiomatic: On jihai day He Zizhi was made army-commanding wanhu and sent as envoy to Siam.

s0132.literal: On xinchou day the property of Ahmad's wife, children, sons-in-law, and slaves was registered.
s0132.idiomatic: On xinchou day the property of Ahmad's wife, children, sons-in-law, and slaves was registered.

s0133.literal: On guimao day the indiscriminate certification of battle merit was forbidden.
s0133.idiomatic: On guimao day the indiscriminate certification of battle merit was forbidden.

s0134.literal: On yisi day unregistered troops were recruited and given clothing and grain.
s0134.idiomatic: On yisi day unregistered troops were recruited and given clothing and grain.

s0135.literal: On jiyou day the crown prince's household guard troops were rewarded for merit in repelling thieves, granted paper currency and horses in graded amounts, and those without wives were matched with confiscated widows.
s0135.idiomatic: On jiyou day the crown prince's household guard troops were rewarded for repelling thieves, granted paper currency and horses in graded amounts, and those without wives were matched with confiscated widows.

s0136.literal: Ahmad's residence was granted to Huluhuosun.
s0136.idiomatic: Ahmad's residence was granted to Huluhuosun.

s0137.literal: On renzi day an edict ordered all officials within and without to decide cases within fixed time limits.
s0137.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict ordered all officials within and without to decide cases within fixed time limits.

s0138.literal: On guichou day, following Huluhuosun's recommendation, the Minister of Education's office and the Agriculture Directorate were abolished.
s0138.idiomatic: On guichou day, following Huluhuosun's recommendation, the Minister of Education's office and the Agriculture Directorate were abolished.

s0139.literal: Husin was shackled and sent to Yangzhou for trial.
s0139.idiomatic: Husin was shackled and sent to Yangzhou for trial.

s0140.literal: On dingsi day Yixibuxue was attacked; his territory was entirely pacified, three-route darughachis were established, garrison troops were left to hold it, Yarlaq Hai was ordered to command overall, and Yesudai'er was made grand commander and pacification commissioner.
s0140.idiomatic: On dingsi day Yixibuxue was attacked and his territory entirely pacified; three-route darughachis were established, garrison troops were left to hold it, Yarlaq Hai was ordered to command overall, and Yesudai'er was made grand commander and pacification commissioner.

s0141.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the wuwu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
s0141.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the wuwu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

s0142.literal: Mobile privy councils were established at Yangzhou and Ezhou.
s0142.idiomatic: Mobile privy councils were established at Yangzhou and Ezhou.

s0143.literal: On gengshen day the Branch Censorate was ordered to weed out surveillance commission officials on each route.
s0143.idiomatic: On gengshen day the branch censorate was ordered to weed out surveillance commission officials on each route.

s0144.literal: On xinyou day Hao Zhen's coffin was opened and his corpse exposed.
s0144.idiomatic: On xinyou day Hao Zhen's coffin was opened and his corpse exposed.

s0145.literal: On renxu day an order directed that official funds supply garrison expenses, while the levies collected by each orlu office were to be returned to the state.
s0145.idiomatic: On renxu day an order directed that official funds supply garrison expenses, while levies collected by each orlu office were to be returned to the state.

s0146.literal: Princes and others were forbidden to employ corvée troops to escort money and goods they operated for profit.
s0146.idiomatic: Princes and others were forbidden to employ corvée troops to escort money and goods they operated for profit.

s0147.literal: The king of Goryeo asked to build one hundred fifty ships himself to assist in the campaign against Japan.
s0147.idiomatic: The king of Goryeo asked to build 150 ships himself to assist in the campaign against Japan.

s0148.literal: On wuchen day troops returning from the Yachi campaign were ordered to garrison-farm in Anxi and were granted paper currency.
s0148.idiomatic: On wuchen day troops returning from the Yachi campaign were ordered to garrison-farm in Anxi and were granted paper currency.

s0149.literal: On gengwu day Mongol troops garrisoning Jiangnan were ordered to rotate home in turns.
s0149.idiomatic: On gengwu day Mongol troops garrisoning Jiangnan were ordered to rotate home in turns.

s0150.literal: On renshen day one thousand troops from Chaghan Na'ur were dispatched to repair the Jinshan road.
s0150.idiomatic: On renshen day 1,000 troops from Chaghan Na'ur were dispatched to repair the Jinshan road.

s0151.literal: The Ma Hu Route general administration was established.
s0151.idiomatic: The Ma Hu Route general administration was established.

s0152.literal: On guiyou day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was granted a gold seal.
s0152.idiomatic: On guiyou day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was granted a gold seal.

s0153.literal: On guiyou day pacification commissioner Meng Qingyuan and wanhu Sun Shengfu, returning as envoys from Java, were imprisoned by Mangudai; an edict ordered them released.
s0153.idiomatic: On guiyou day pacification commissioner Meng Qingyuan and wanhu Sun Shengfu, returning as envoys from Java, were imprisoned by Mangudai; an edict ordered them released.

s0154.literal: On dingchou day Wang Zha'er, chief commander, was dismissed and his patent of appointment and tiger tally were confiscated.
s0154.idiomatic: On dingchou day chief commander Wang Zha'er was dismissed and his patent of appointment and tiger tally were confiscated.

s0155.literal: Gongchang Route darughachi Biesu Temür was made darughachi of the Gongchang-Pingliang and twenty-three other places field headquarters for military convenience.
s0155.idiomatic: Gongchang Route darughachi Biesu Temür was made darughachi of the Gongchang-Pingliang and 23 other places field headquarters for military convenience.

s0156.literal: The Mongol Boluo was placed in charge of gold-washing in Chen, Yuan, and other prefectures of Hubei.
s0156.idiomatic: The Mongol Boluo was placed in charge of gold-washing in Chen, Yuan, and other prefectures of Hubei.

s0157.literal: On wuyin day deliberation was held on building the Ashadabusu imperial city; the Privy Council said: "It would require one hundred twenty thousand timbers, and the distance makes them hard to obtain; it would be better to build earthen walls as at Chaghan Na'ur.
s0157.idiomatic: On wuyin day deliberation was held on building the Ashadabusu imperial city; the Privy Council said, "It would require 120,000 timbers, and the distance makes them hard to obtain; it would be better to build earthen walls as at Chaghan Na'ur.

s0159.literal: On yiyou day Princes Tahai Temür, Hudutemür, and others were granted gold, silver, and fabrics in graded amounts.
s0159.idiomatic: On yiyou day princes Tahai Temür, Hudutemür, and others received gold, silver, and fabrics in graded amounts.

s0160.literal: Java sent tribute of a gold pagoda.
s0160.idiomatic: Java sent tribute of a gold pagoda.

s0161.literal: Grain was issued in relief to the poor among the Kirghiz.
s0161.idiomatic: Grain was issued in relief to the poor among the Kirghiz.

s0162.literal: Eighth month, on the dinghai new moon, winter clothing was issued to shipbuilding craftsmen at Qianshan, and paper currency to newly submitted troops.
s0162.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the dinghai new moon, winter clothing was issued to shipbuilding craftsmen at Qianshan, and paper currency to newly submitted troops.

s0163.literal: On gengyin day Mangudai returned from campaigning against Luoshi Ghost Country, still wore a tiger tally, and was made army-commanding wanhu.
s0163.idiomatic: On gengyin day Mangudai returned from campaigning against Luoshi Ghost Country, still wore a tiger tally, and was made army-commanding wanhu.

s0164.literal: On xinmao day Abaqchi was ordered to supervise grain transport.
s0164.idiomatic: On xinmao day Abaqchi was ordered to supervise grain transport.

s0165.literal: On guisi day Luorosi and other troops were dispatched to assist in the campaign against Burma.
s0165.idiomatic: On guisi day Luorosi and other troops were dispatched to assist in the campaign against Burma.

s0166.literal: On xinhai day the Tian and Suo stockades of Zilai Route were merged, and a new Xincheng County seat was established at Yitai.
s0166.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Tian and Suo stockades of Zilai Route were merged, and a new Xincheng County seat was established at Yitai.

s0167.literal: The imperial procession halted at Longhu Terrace.
s0167.idiomatic: The imperial procession halted at Longhu Terrace.

s0168.literal: Flooding in Jiangnan left many people starving;
s0168.idiomatic: Flooding in Jiangnan left many people starving;

s0169.literal: south of Zhending drought drove many people to flee;
s0169.idiomatic: south of Zhending drought drove many people to flee;

s0170.literal: Huluhuosun asked that local offices open granaries for relief; this was granted.
s0170.idiomatic: Huluhuosun asked that local offices open granaries for relief; the request was granted.

s0171.literal: The prohibition on gilding carriages, horses, and apparel was strictly enforced.
s0171.idiomatic: The prohibition on gilding carriages, horses, and apparel was strictly enforced.

s0172.literal: Directorate officials were also forbidden to have artisans privately make utensils.
s0172.idiomatic: Directorate officials were also forbidden to have artisans privately make utensils.

s0173.literal: On jiayin day, the Emperor's birthday, the court returned to the palace that day.
s0173.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the emperor's birthday, the court returned to the palace that day.

s0174.literal: On yimao day the Emperor held court in the main hall and received New Year's greetings from the crown prince, princes, and all officials.
s0174.idiomatic: On yimao day the emperor held court in the main hall and received New Year's greetings from the crown prince, princes, and all officials.

s0175.literal: On bingchen day Nie'udienn was banished to garrison Champa to redeem his crime.
s0175.idiomatic: On bingchen day Nie'udienn was banished to garrison Champa to redeem his crime.

s0176.literal: Ninth month, on the dingsi new moon, starving people in Zhending were relieved; those who had fled to Jiangnan were given grain by the state to return home.
s0176.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the dingsi new moon, starving people in Zhending were relieved; those who had fled to Jiangnan were given grain by the state to return home.

s0177.literal: An edict ordered the Central Secretariat to thoroughly investigate Ahmad's faction.
s0177.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Central Secretariat to thoroughly investigate Ahmad's faction.

s0178.literal: Biesudai asked to establish relay stations at Luobo and Zhelihui; this was granted.
s0178.idiomatic: Biesudai asked to establish relay stations at Luobo and Zhelihui; the request was granted.

s0179.literal: Ahmad's confiscated fields were made garrison farms, and Ali's household was registered.
s0179.idiomatic: Ahmad's confiscated fields were made garrison farms, and Ali's household was registered.

s0180.literal: On wuwu day Ahmad's third son Asan was executed, and his skin was flayed as a public warning.
s0180.idiomatic: On wuwu day Ahmad's third son Asan was executed, and his skin was flayed as a public warning.

s0181.literal: On gengshen day redundant officials were cut.
s0181.idiomatic: On gengshen day redundant officials were cut.

s0182.literal: You Xian asked to abolish the Lian and Haizhou garrison farms and place their affairs under civilian officials; his request was granted, and You Xian was additionally made grand councillor and sent to administer the branch secretariat at Yangzhou.
s0182.idiomatic: You Xian asked to abolish the Lian and Haizhou garrison farms and place their affairs under civilian officials; his request was granted, and You Xian was additionally made grand councillor and sent to administer the branch secretariat at Yangzhou.

s0183.literal: The Fujian pacification commission captured a Japanese spy; an edict ordered him detained.
s0183.idiomatic: The Fujian pacification commission captured a Japanese spy; an edict ordered him detained.

s0184.literal: On xinyou day Geng Ren, Sadurudin, and Ahmad's fourth son Xindu were executed.
s0184.idiomatic: On xinyou day Geng Ren, Sadurudin, and Ahmad's fourth son Xindu were executed.

s0185.literal: Campaign commissioner Yang Tingjian won over the overseas countries, and the southern fan all dispatched envoys with tribute.
s0185.idiomatic: Campaign commissioner Yang Tingjian won over the overseas countries, and the southern fan all sent envoys with tribute.

s0186.literal: The lord of Jolan sent envoys with a memorial, presenting precious objects and one black ape.
s0186.idiomatic: The lord of Jolan sent envoys with a memorial, presenting precious objects and one black ape.

s0187.literal: The lord of Nawan, Mang'ang, because his country had no literate persons, dispatched four envoys without presenting a memorial.
s0187.idiomatic: The lord of Nawan, Mang'ang, because his country had no literate persons, sent four envoys without presenting a memorial.

s0188.literal: The lord of Sumudusu also dispatched two envoys.
s0188.idiomatic: The lord of Sumudusu also sent two envoys.

s0189.literal: Sumuda chancellor Nali Bahala Tanchi, being in Jolan on business, on hearing the edict sent envoys in place of his lord Dagur with a memorial, presenting rings, printed brocade, and twenty sets of brocade quilts.
s0189.idiomatic: Sumuda chancellor Nali Bahala Tanchi, being in Jolan on business, on hearing the edict sent envoys in place of his lord Dagur with a memorial, presenting rings, printed brocade, and 20 sets of brocade quilts.

s0190.literal: The Nestorian chief residing in Jolan, Wuzan'er Pielima, also sent envoys with a memorial, presenting one seven-jewel neck plaque and two bottles of medicine.
s0190.idiomatic: The Nestorian chief residing in Jolan, Wuzan'er Pielima, also sent envoys with a memorial, presenting one seven-jewel neck plaque and two bottles of medicine.

s0191.literal: Mahama, overseer of the Musuman, also sent envoys with a memorial, arriving at court the same day.
s0191.idiomatic: Mahama, overseer of the Musuman, also sent envoys with a memorial, arriving at court the same day.

s0192.literal: On renxu day all persons were forbidden to obstruct tax collection.
s0192.idiomatic: On renxu day all persons were forbidden to obstruct tax collection.

s0193.literal: An edict: "Officials who accept bribes and granary officials who embezzle, if surveillance officials know but do not impeach, shall be punished according to the gravity of the offense.
s0193.idiomatic: An edict ordered: "Officials who accept bribes and granary officials who embezzle, if surveillance officials know but do not impeach, shall be punished according to the gravity of the offense.

s0194.literal: Officials within and without who commit corruption, the lighter cases shall be beaten and decided, the heavier shall be put to death.
s0194.idiomatic: Officials within and without who commit corruption: lighter cases shall be beaten and decided, heavier cases shall be put to death.

s0195.literal: Remonstrating officials who keep silent shall be punished as one with those who accept bribes.
s0195.idiomatic: Remonstrating officials who keep silent shall be punished the same as those who accept bribes.

s0196.literal: " An edict was also issued proclaiming this throughout the realm.
s0196.idiomatic: " An edict was also issued proclaiming this throughout the realm.

s0197.literal: On yichou day troops were levied in Yixibuxue and other places.
s0197.idiomatic: On yichou day troops were levied in Yixibuxue and other places.

s0198.literal: On dingmao day Annam sent tribute of rhinoceros, elephants, gold and silver vessels, incense, and medicines.
s0198.idiomatic: On dingmao day Annam sent tribute of rhinoceros, elephants, gold and silver vessels, incense, and medicines.

s0199.literal: Additional winter-clothing paper currency was granted to the army of commander-in-chief Qi Gongzhi.
s0199.idiomatic: Additional winter-clothing paper currency was granted to the army of commander-in-chief Qi Gongzhi.

s0200.literal: On jisi day military relay households were ordered to contribute money to assist the people's corvée purchases and labor hires.
s0200.idiomatic: On jisi day military relay households were ordered to contribute money to assist the people's corvée purchases and labor hires.
